theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_st_cd_c1_pieces_of_lipschitzOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (u : Eucl n → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), IsOpen Ω → LipschitzOnWith K u Ω → ∃ (h : ℕ → Eucl n → ℝ) (A : ℕ → Set (Eucl n)), (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (h k)) ∧ (∀ k, A k ⊆ Ω) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ w ∈ A k, u w = h k w ∧ HasFDerivAt u (fderiv ℝ (h k) w) w) ∧ (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) (Ω \ ⋃ k, A k) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
